title: 37 Lake District Lane | 4BR Rental in WaterColor | Royal Destinations
meta_description: 37 Lake District Lane is a signature 4BR WaterColor home steps from Seaside featuring a 2020 remodel and Beach Club access. This rental sleeps 12 by Royal Destinations.
description_expanded: Description: 37 Lake District Lane by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor Address: 37 Lake District Lane Details: Located in phase one of the WaterColor community, you are sure to love this charming newly remodeled 4-bedroom, 4.5 bathroom modern 3,000-square-foot home. With 37 Lake District Lane sitting behind Seaside, the Tennis Center just a block away, only a few short minutes from the beautiful beaches of the Gulf of Mexico, and the WaterColor Beach Club, 37 Lake District Lane is the perfect vacation home, and everything will be at your fingertips. Park your car and enjoy all that WaterColor has to offer – the beach, Western Lake, four pools, biking and hiking trails, shops, and restaurants. 37 Lake District Lane is guaranteed to be a vacation filled with wonderful and lasting memories with the family. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 12) - Steps From Seaside - 2 Living Rooms - Spacious Screened-In Porch - Parking for 2 Vehicles (Garage Access Not Available) - Propane Gas Grill - Fireplace - Exterior Shower - Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Cottage District - Steps Away from Tennis Courts - 0.5 miles to Watercolor Beach Club WaterColor Neighborhood Highlights: -Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. -WaterColor provides a free, on-demand trolley for guests, available daily with seasonal hours through the WaterColor Trolley app. For more information, contact our Reservations Team. -A 499-acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community -Bike Community -Award-Winning Tennis Facilities -Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining -Nearby State Parks and Preserves -4 Swimming Pools Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 5 Bathrooms First Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower - Half Bathroom -Laundry Room Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed, Twin Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub/ Shower Combination. - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Twin Bed, Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination - Guest Bedroom 4: Queen Bed, Full Bed, Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service Please Note: -Golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis. -Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- We love our home at 37 Lake District Lane for the memories we've made and the peaceful, tucked-away location in WaterColor’s Phase I. It’s a quiet, forested spot just a short walk or bike ride to Seaside, the Beach Club, pools, and the Tennis Center. We enjoy hearing the chapel bells, watching weddings from our porch, and rarely needing a car—biking to Publix or strolling into Seaside for sunsets and dinner. After a 2020 remodel, the home now has two cozy living areas, perfect for families, plus a screened porch with a swinging bed. It’s our happy place—we just wish we could be there more often.
